verdict.rationale: QuickBooks docs confirm bank feed import, reconciliation workflow, auto-generated reconciliation reports, and discrepancy reports (missing checks, reconciliation discrepancy report) which help surface issues, plus rule-based auto-matching per community comment. However, no explicit documentation describes a UI that separately surfaces 'matched vs unmatched vs duplicate' transactions as distinct categories during reconciliation, and one community report notes feature gaps vs desktop. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a matched/unmatched/duplicate transaction review screen, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific UI behavior.
